reason: Both replies find the main gap: the draft doesn't say what happens to members the next time weather ruins the crops. Reply B's suggestions match what Sam can actually commit to: a credit when boxes fall below a set level, and updates every week. B also puts the fixes in a clear order and flags that the $31,000 line could read as "don't expect money back." Reply A spends more of its advice on a $74 make-good that Sam never offered.
